name: Larry OG
summary: Larry OG is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from Orange County, California, a cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[sfv-og|SFV OG]] also sold as Lemon Larry. Weedmaps credits [[breeder:The Cali Connection]], whose Larry OG Kush, a cross back to SFV OG, won at the High Times Medical Cannabis Cup in 2012 and 2014.

sources.title: Larry OG
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the OG Kush x SFV OG cross, the Orange County origin, and the Lemon Larry alias.
